title: More Recipies
description: A small collection of quality of life recipes to make mass crafting easier, or advanced recipes for non-creatable blocks and items.
body:
# More Recipies - Minecraft Datapack
Tired of tedious crafting? This datapack overhauls vanilla recipes to make crafting faster, smarter, and more efficient—while keeping the vanilla feel!
## 🔹 Features
### 🪵 Log-Based Crafting
- Chests
- Trapdoors
- Doors
- Sticks
- Slabs
- Stairs
- Pressure Plates
### 🌱 Instant Plant Duplication
Flowers → Duplicate with just bonemeal
Crops (wheat, carrots, potatoes, etc.) → Duplicate with bonemeal
### ⚡ Heavy Core & Conduit Crafting
- Heavy Core (requires Conduit, Amethyst Shards, Echo Shards, Netherite Ingot, Nether Star) 
- Conduit (requires Heavy Core, Amethyst Shards, Echo Shards, Netherite Ingot, Nether Star)
### 🎨 Banner Color Swapping
Convert any colored banner into any other color easily!
### 🧑‍🌾 Easier Villager Workstations
Craft workstations with logs + 1 extra ingredient:
Loom → Logs + Wool (gives 2 looms)
Other workstations (e.g., Fletching Table, Smithing Table, etc.) → Logs + ingredient (gives 1)
## 🔹 Why Use This Datapack?
✅ Saves time – Skip unnecessary crafting steps!

✅ Less grinding – Duplicate plants & craft rare items easier. 

✅ Fully vanilla-friendly – No mods needed! 

✅ Great for survival, builders & speedrunners! 
## 📥 Download & Install
Drop the datapack into your world's datapacks folder.
Enjoy smoother crafting in Minecraft!
Works in Singleplayer & Multiplayer!
